subject: general
question: ‘Dumhal’ is the famous dance form of which of the following states/union territories?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jammu and Kashmir.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Watal clan **performs the **dumhal dance** in the Indian province of **Jammu & Kashmir.**
 
• This dance can only be performed by the** women of the Watal **on particular days and in designated places.
 
• This dance style is well known for its** vibrant costumes and lovely embellishments**, which primarily consist of excellent **"bead work."**
 
• A **"conical cap" **made of** beads **and **ornamental shells** is also part of the clothing for this dance style.
 
• The other famous dance forms of Jammu and Kashmir include **Rauf, Hikat, Mandjas, Kud Dandi Nach, Damali.​**​
